identity.description: Name a workflow for the history panel; produces no rows.
identity.when_to_use: At the head of a canvas whose runs should be grouped by a readable name.

ai.summary: 工作流命名 is pure metadata: it names the run and must feed a real node.
when_not_to_use: Not for naming the exported file: that is node.output.
prerequisites: A canvas that holds at least one data-producing node downstream.
steps: Put 工作流命名 at the head of the canvas (no incoming wire).
Type the run name; a blank name is refused before the run and in history grouping.
Wire it into the node whose work the name describes.
failures: Blank workflow_name: refused with engine.name_no_label.
An incoming wire: refused with engine.name_not_head.
No outgoing wire: refused with engine.name_no_downstream.
acceptance: Validate reports no error for this node.
The history panel groups the run under the typed name.

identity.description: Crawl one platform in one mode and emit its rows.
identity.when_to_use: When the corpus is a platform search, a board, an author page or a link list.

ai.summary: 数据源 crawls one platform with one mode and emits that mode’s table (a search, a board, an author page, a note/article list, or one link list). The platform matrix decides the fields, the required values and whether the mode needs a saved login.
when_not_to_use: A local file corpus belongs on node.upload; comments under known links belong on node.comment.
prerequisites: A platform and a mode this build offers; the matrix answers both.
A saved login for a mode whose session is required.
Reachable network for the platform.
steps: Pick a platform, then an engine (Selenium or CatBus) and a mode; the form shows that cell’s fields.
Fill the mode’s required fields (a keyword, a board, a link list or an author link).
Pick the login account when the mode needs a session; anonymous modes are not asked.
failures: No platform: engine.source_no_platform.
A platform/mode this matrix does not offer: engine.source_unknown_platform / _unknown_mode.
A missing required field: engine.source_missing; a value off the offered list: engine.source_bad_option.
A session-required mode whose account holds no login: the preflight keys.
acceptance: The run stores rows with the columns the mode declares.
A login wall or risk page is named in the console, never settled as an empty table.

identity.description: Publish a stored dataset (upload/paste/import) as rows for downstream nodes.
identity.when_to_use: When the corpus is a file rather than a crawl: the one place a file enters a workflow.

ai.summary: 文件上传 turns one stored dataset into the same row table a crawl produces. Downstream nodes never know the difference; the dataset id is the binding.
when_not_to_use: A crawl belongs on node.source; a file outside the dataset store belongs on workspace_import first.
prerequisites: A stored dataset id (upload, paste or import in the data panel).
steps: Upload or paste a file in the data panel and note its dataset id.
Create 文件上传 and pick the dataset.
Wire it into 清洗/分词/分析 as if it were a crawl.
failures: No dataset_id: refused with engine.upload_no_file before the run.
The dataset was deleted and no name/row-count replacement exists: the executor refuses instead of returning [].
acceptance: The node emits as many rows as the dataset holds.
A missing dataset settles with a named refusal, not an empty table.

identity.description: Adopt a stored node output from an earlier run as this node’s rows.
identity.when_to_use: When the original source cannot run again but its rows are already paid for.

ai.summary: 断点续采 adopts rows an earlier run already stored. Blank ids mean “newest unfinished run of this workflow shape, fullest node”; a limit truncates the adopted table.
when_not_to_use: Not a repair: a source that can run again is cheaper than adopting an older result.
Not for copying one node between canvases.
prerequisites: An earlier run of this workflow shape that stored rows.
Optionally the run id and node id to adopt; blank means the automatic choice.
steps: Pick a resumable run and node, or leave both blank for the automatic choice.
Optionally set a row limit.
Wire the adopted rows into the rest of the chain.
failures: No resumable run: the executor logs resume.no_run and returns no rows.
The picked node holds nothing and no node has rows: resume.empty.
acceptance: The node emits the adopted rows and the run shows them as this node's output.
A run without stored rows reports resume.empty instead of zero rows.

identity.description: Crawl the comments of article links (or 红果 titles) into one row table.
identity.when_to_use: When the post table is known and the comments under each post are the corpus.

ai.summary: 评论采集 walks the comments of the article links on one form, batch by batch, and emits the same comment table a 数据源 in comments mode produces (评论内容/评论时间/点赞数/文章URL …). The cursor records only the leading links it PROVED complete, so 继续 replays from the first hole.
when_not_to_use: A platform mode that already emits comments belongs on node.source.
A post table that only needs a chart is not a comment crawl.
prerequisites: One article link per line, or a title where the platform matrix declares names.
A saved login for each platform the links name; the wall is per account.
A comment budget when the crawl should stop early.
steps: Paste article links (one per line); a 红果 title is accepted where the matrix declares names.
Pick the login account — the comment wall is a per-account rate limit, which is why accounts exist.
Set comment_limit (0 = every comment), part_size and whether parts are kept.
failures: No links: engine.comment_no_urls.
The account holds no login for a platform a link names: engine.source_no_cookie_account.
A @pool account with no saved login / all cooling: engine.source_pool_empty / _cooling.
A walled or short link settles PARTIAL and keeps its cursor hole, so 继续 re-walks it.
acceptance: The node stores the comment table with content/time/likes/article URL.
Every blocked link stays a cursor hole and is reported as PARTIAL.

identity.description: Clean, tokenize or analyze a text column; emits per-operation columns.
identity.when_to_use: After a crawl/upload when the rows need cleaning or one text/algorithm operation.

ai.summary: 处理 runs one operation over the upstream text column: cleaning, tokenize, word frequency, TF-IDF/TextRank, sentiment/emotion/tendency, NER, clustering, correlation and the qualitative coding operations. The operation selects both the result columns and the required inputs.
when_not_to_use: A multi-step table pipeline belongs on node.analysis.
A reusable procedural step belongs on node.python.
prerequisites: An upstream table with a text column.
For BERT operations: a model that is installed and runnable; an unrunnable one is refused by name.
steps: Pick the operation; the panel shows only that operation’s fields.
Pick the text column (正文 is the usual crawl column).
For BERT operations choose one model, or several for the comparison table.
failures: No operation: engine.process_no_op.
Tokenize without a text column: engine.tokenize_no_column.
An unknown operation/param value: the executor refuses with analysis.bad_option and the allowed values.
acceptance: Validate is green and the emitted columns are the operation’s own.
A missing text column is named with the columns the table has.

identity.description: Run a saved Python script over the upstream rows (local/desktop only).
identity.when_to_use: When a transformation is not one of the built-in operations and should be reused as a script.

ai.summary: Python 节点 runs one saved script from the account’s script library over the upstream rows. The script reads CIXI_INPUT and writes CIXI_OUTPUT (JSON Lines); the node stores its id, not code.
when_not_to_use: When a built-in operation exists, use node.process first (capability-first policy).
Cloud mode has no Python and refuses this node by name.
prerequisites: A script saved in the account script library.
Local or desktop mode with ai_allow_python on.
Upstream rows in the CIXI_INPUT JSONL contract.
steps: Save or pick a script in the Python panel.
Wire the rows in and set args (a JSON object the script reads from CIXI_ARGS).
Keep timeout/max_rows within the script’s needs; the runtime caps the output rows.
failures: Cloud mode: refused by name (ai.pythonCloud).
No/unknown script: refused with ai.pythonUnknown.
Bad args JSON: ai.pythonArgs; bad timeout/max_rows: ai.pythonBadNumber.
acceptance: The node returns rows written to CIXI_OUTPUT and a zero exit code.
A failed script names its stderr instead of settling an empty table.

identity.description: Run a pipeline of data-analysis steps (filter, join, group, statistics, LDA, …).
identity.when_to_use: When rows need a multi-step table transformation; a single text operation belongs on 处理.

ai.summary: 数据分析 runs an ordered pipeline of operators over one table: filter/select/rename/join/group, statistics, text analysis (keyword/topic/LDA) and chart-ready aggregates. Each operator declares the columns it reads and the columns it emits.
when_not_to_use: One text operation belongs on node.process; a chart belongs on node.visualize.
prerequisites: An upstream table.
Every column a step reads exists upstream; the step refuses by name otherwise.
steps: Add steps in order; each step is {op, ...params}.
A step that reads a column refuses by name when the column is absent upstream.
The analysis node emits the columns of the last step plus passthrough columns.
failures: No steps and no operation: engine.analysis_no_op.
An unknown operator/parameter: data_analysis.validate_step names it with the allowed values.
A missing input column: the step refuses by name rather than guessing.
acceptance: The output carries the last step’s columns.
A zero-row result from non-empty input is reported as engine.empty_output.

identity.description: Segment a text column into words and emit word frequencies or one word per row.
identity.when_to_use: When a later step needs word frequencies or one word per row: word cloud, bar chart, corpus statistics. Use the process node for cleaning-only passes.

ai.summary: 分词 turns one text column into a word table: word/frequency pairs, bare words, or a single space-joined line. The upstream rows are the corpus; the node never reads a file itself.
when_not_to_use: Cleaning or one text operation belongs on node.process.
Corpus statistics belong on node.analysis.
prerequisites: An upstream table with a text column.
steps: Wire a node that produces text rows into 分词.
Pick the text column and an output mode.
For word_freq, optionally cap the table with top_n (blank means the executor default).
failures: No text column configured: refuses before the run with engine.tokenize_no_column.
The column is absent from the upstream table: the executor names the column and the columns it saw.
No upstream rows: the executor refuses instead of settling an empty table DONE.
acceptance: The word table has word/frequency columns and no blank words.
An absent text column is named with the columns seen.

identity.description: Build a bibliometric network/table (co-occurrence, coupling, bursts) from records.
identity.when_to_use: After 文献融合 or a CNKI import, when the records should become a citation/co-word map.

ai.summary: 文献计量 builds a bibliometric network from a record table: co-occurrence, co-citation or coupling, with slice/look-back windows, top-N/G-index/threshold selection, LRF/MST/Pathfinder pruning, cluster labels (LLR/LSI/MI/TF-IDF), burst detection, structural variation, and five output shapes (nodes/edges/clusters/bursts/variation/dual_map).
when_not_to_use: Merging several record tables belongs on node.fuse first.
Drawing the network belongs on node.visualize.
prerequisites: A record table with the entity column the chosen network reads.
The year/title/reference columns only when the chosen network reads them.
steps: Pick the entity type and the columns the record table really has.
Choose the selection rule and the link measure; pruning is for a graph too dense to read.
Pick the output shape: nodes/edges for a graph, clusters/bursts/variation for their tables, dual_map for a basemap overlay.
failures: An option outside its list: biblio.bad_option names the parameter and the allowed values.
A number outside its range: biblio.bad_option (the validator states the range).
A start year after the end year: biblio.time_range.
Fractional counting on a coupling network: biblio.counting_no_coupling.
Bursts on a coupling network: biblio.coupling_no_burst.
An output shape whose switch is off: biblio.shape_needs_cluster/burst/variation.
A baseline without a project: biblio.watch_needs_project; monitoring a non-entity shape: biblio.watch_needs_entity_table.
acceptance: The chosen output shape exists and its node/edge/cluster/burst counts are reported.
An option outside its list is named with the allowed values.

identity.description: Compare a promised list with a crawl result and report missing/short items.
identity.when_to_use: After a comment crawl, when the list says how many comments each post should have.

ai.summary: 采集校验 reads two tables: the promised list and the crawled result. It matches keys, compares the expected count (评论数) with the actual rows, and emits 采集状态/期望条数/实际条数/缺失条数/完成度.
when_not_to_use: For an exact count over one table use dataset_query; this node compares two tables.
prerequisites: Two tables: the promised list first and the crawl result second (or swap_tables).
Key columns that exist in both tables.
steps: Wire the promised list in first and the crawl result in second (or set swap_tables).
Name the list key, the result key and the expected-count column.
Choose gaps for the re-crawl feed or all for the audit.
failures: Not exactly two data parents: engine.verify_two_inputs.
Missing list/result key: engine.verify_need_list_col/result_col.
A key column absent from its table: the executor names the column.
acceptance: The output counts missing and short items per key.
Both key columns are named when absent.

identity.description: Merge several source tables into ONE canonical bibliographic record table.
identity.when_to_use: When CNKI/platform tables from different sources should become one record set.

params.name: entity_columns
params.default: 关键词,话题,主题,主题词,标签

params.name: year_columns
params.default: 年份,发布时间,发表日期,日期

params.name: author_columns
params.default: 作者,用户名,昵称,发布者

ai.summary: 文献融合 merges several source tables into one canonical record table: each role (entity, year, title, author, affiliation, text, reference, source) declares candidate column names, and the first candidate a source really has answers the role.
when_not_to_use: Comment rows are not bibliographic records; use node.accumulate for repeated appends of one shape.
prerequisites: One or more source tables.
At least the entity role must find a column; the other roles may stay empty.
steps: Wire every source table in.
Keep or edit the candidate column lists per role; at least the entity role must find a column.
Choose whether undated records are kept and whether per-source files are exported.

params.entity_columns: 关键词,话题,主题,主题词,标签

failures: No input table: fuse.no_input.
No entity candidate found: fuse.needs_entity names the node.
Differing source columns are normalized per role; a missing role is left empty, never guessed.
acceptance: One canonical table exists with a source column and the declared roles.
No entity candidate is refused as fuse.needs_entity.

identity.description: Append the upstream rows to a named lineage (by whole row or by key columns).
identity.when_to_use: When repeated runs should accumulate into one growing dataset instead of separate files.

ai.summary: 数据累积 appends the rows passing through it into a named lineage. ``identity=row`` appends every row; ``identity=columns`` appends only rows whose key columns are not already present.
when_not_to_use: A standalone file belongs on node.output; a one-off result should not grow a lineage.
prerequisites: Exactly one table producer upstream.
A lineage name that stays the same across runs.
Key columns when identity is columns.
steps: Name the lineage (the same name across runs accumulates together).
Choose row identity or key columns; key columns are required for the column mode.
Wire exactly one table producer in.
failures: Blank lineage name: engine.accumulate_no_name.
Unknown identity or column mode without keys: engine.accumulate_bad_identity/no_keys.
Not exactly one parent, or a non-table parent: engine.accumulate_one_parent/bad_parent.
acceptance: The lineage grows by the rows (or the new keys) of this run.
A non-table or second parent is refused by name.

identity.description: Build an ECharts/matplotlib chart (plus LaTeX) from the upstream table.
identity.when_to_use: When rows should become a chart; a PDF document belongs on PDF 编译.

ai.summary: 可视化 builds one chart from the upstream rows: an ECharts option or a matplotlib image, plus optional LaTeX figure/table. The chart type decides which fields it reads; the fields it requires are refused before a run.
when_not_to_use: Several charts into one PDF belong on node.compile.
A table export belongs on node.output; a chart is not a file save.
prerequisites: An upstream table.
The fields the chosen chart declares; validate names a blank required box.
The engine this build serves (echarts or matplotlib).
steps: Pick the chart type (词云, 柱状图, 主题距离图, 文献共现, …).
Pick the x/y/value/label fields; a chart that needs no x says so.
Turn on LaTeX outputs only when a PDF 编译/保存 will consume them.
failures: A required field is blank: engine.chart_field_missing names the chart and the box.
A chart type this build does not serve: engine.chart_unknown (the declared default is the fix).
A box plot with neither x nor y: engine.chart_field_group_missing.
acceptance: The chart option or image exists for the run and the LaTeX switches match the request.
A missing required field is named before the run.

identity.description: Assemble the LaTeX from visualize parents and compile it to a PDF.
identity.when_to_use: When several charts/tables should become one PDF; a single chart can be saved directly.

ai.summary: PDF 编译 collects the LaTeX emitted by visualize parents and compiles one document. It reads parent artifacts, not rows, and refuses an empty source instead of producing a blank PDF.
when_not_to_use: One chart is saved directly; a table export belongs on node.output.
This node only assembles LaTeX parents, it does not read rows.
prerequisites: At least one visualize parent.
That parent has LaTeX figure and/or table switched on.
steps: Turn on 输出 LaTeX and/or LaTeX 表格 on every visualize parent.
Wire those visualize nodes into PDF 编译.
Wire the compile node into 保存 when the PDF needs a user-chosen filename.
failures: No parent: engine.compile_no_upstream.
A parent is not a visualize node: engine.compile_bad_parent names it.
A visualize parent has both LaTeX boxes off: engine.compile_source_both_off names it.
acceptance: A PDF file exists for the run.
A parent that is not a visualize node or has both LaTeX boxes off is named.

identity.description: Merge incoming tables (or a PDF source) into one exported file.
identity.when_to_use: At the end of a chain when the rows or the PDF need a file on disk.

ai.summary: 保存 merges every incoming table into one file, or saves a PDF from visualize/compile parents. Column sets must match; the executor refuses a merge rather than exporting only the first table.
when_not_to_use: Intermediate results stay on the canvas; a reusable growing table belongs on node.accumulate.
prerequisites: Table parents with matching columns, or visualize/compile parents for a PDF.
A filename; the exporter appends the extension.
steps: Wire one or more table producers into 保存 for a tabular export.
For a PDF, choose format=pdf (or a .pdf filename) and wire visualize/compile parents only.
Set the filename; the exporter appends the format extension when it is missing.
failures: No parent: engine.output_no_upstream.
A PDF save mixed with table parents: engine.output_pdf_mixed.
A PDF save with no visualize/compile parent: engine.output_pdf_only_pdfable.
Both a visualize and a compile PDF source: engine.output_pdf_two_sources.
A table save fed only by a PDF source: engine.output_needs_pdf.
acceptance: The exported file exists and its row count matches the merged input.
Mixed table and PDF parents are refused by name.

identity.description: 删除所选列中含空值的行（任一为空或全部为空）。
identity.when_to_use: 在分析前去掉缺字段的行，或只保留每一列都填写完整的行。

ai.summary: 删除所选列中含空值的行（任一为空或全部为空）。
when_not_to_use: 只想填补空值而不是删除行时用 fill_null；要按列去重用 drop_duplicates。
prerequisites: An upstream table (the analysis node’s input).
`columns` names existing columns; blank means every column.
steps: Put a step `{"op": "drop_null", …}` in the analysis node’s `steps`, or set `operation` to `drop_null`.
A missing column, a blank required box or a value outside a declared select refuses by name.
failures: A named column the table does not hold: `analysis.step_col_missing`.
A blank required parameter: `analysis.need_param`.
A value outside a declared select: `analysis.bad_option`.
acceptance: Rows are filtered or reordered; the upstream columns are unchanged.

identity.description: 用固定值或上/下一行的值填补所选列的空单元格。
identity.when_to_use: 缺失值是“未填写”而不是“不存在”时，保留行并补上占位值。

ai.summary: 用固定值或上/下一行的值填补所选列的空单元格。
when_not_to_use: 行本身没有意义（缺了关键字段就该丢弃）时用 drop_null。
prerequisites: An upstream table (the analysis node’s input).
`columns` names existing columns; blank means every column.
steps: Put a step `{"op": "fill_null", …}` in the analysis node’s `steps`, or set `operation` to `fill_null`.
A missing column, a blank required box or a value outside a declared select refuses by name.
failures: A named column the table does not hold: `analysis.step_col_missing`.
A blank required parameter: `analysis.need_param`.
A value outside a declared select: `analysis.bad_option`.
acceptance: Rows are filtered or reordered; the upstream columns are unchanged.

identity.description: 按所选列删除重复行；exact 逐字比较，normalized 先做全半角/空白归一。
identity.when_to_use: 同一行被采集了两次（翻页重叠、导出合并）时去重。

ai.summary: 按所选列删除重复行；exact 逐字比较，normalized 先做全半角/空白归一。
when_not_to_use: 两段文字意思相同但写法不同时用 dedupe_similar 或 semantic_dedupe。
prerequisites: An upstream table (the analysis node’s input).
`columns` names existing columns; blank means every column.
steps: Put a step `{"op": "drop_duplicates", …}` in the analysis node’s `steps`, or set `operation` to `drop_duplicates`.
A missing column, a blank required box or a value outside a declared select refuses by name.
failures: A named column the table does not hold: `analysis.step_col_missing`.
A blank required parameter: `analysis.need_param`.
A value outside a declared select: `analysis.bad_option`.
acceptance: Rows are filtered or reordered; the upstream columns are unchanged.

identity.description: 按一列文本的 SimHash 距离删除近似重复行（改写、加表情、换标点）。
identity.when_to_use: 评论/转发里同一句话被改写多次时，保留一条代表。

ai.summary: 按一列文本的 SimHash 距离删除近似重复行（改写、加表情、换标点）。
when_not_to_use: 需要语义相似（同义改写）时用 semantic_dedupe；逐字重复用 drop_duplicates。
prerequisites: An upstream table (the analysis node’s input).
`column` names a column that must exist (default: none — required).
steps: Put a step `{"op": "dedupe_similar", …}` in the analysis node’s `steps`, or set `operation` to `dedupe_similar`.
A missing column, a blank required box or a value outside a declared select refuses by name.
failures: A named column the table does not hold: `analysis.step_col_missing`.
A blank required parameter: `analysis.need_param`.
A value outside a declared select: `analysis.bad_option`.
acceptance: Rows are filtered or reordered; the upstream columns are unchanged.

identity.description: 用本地句向量比较一列文本，删掉语义重复的行（同义改写也算）。
identity.when_to_use: 同一观点被换词重写多次，需要按意思去重时。

ai.summary: 用本地句向量比较一列文本，删掉语义重复的行（同义改写也算）。
when_not_to_use: 只是字面相近用 dedupe_similar；要按关键词找相似行用 similar_to。
prerequisites: An upstream table (the analysis node’s input).
`column` names a column that must exist (default: none — required).
steps: Put a step `{"op": "semantic_dedupe", …}` in the analysis node’s `steps`, or set `operation` to `semantic_dedupe`.
A missing column, a blank required box or a value outside a declared select refuses by name.
failures: A named column the table does not hold: `analysis.step_col_missing`.
A blank required parameter: `analysis.need_param`.
A value outside a declared select: `analysis.bad_option`.
acceptance: Rows are filtered or reordered; the upstream columns are unchanged.

identity.description: 用本地句向量找出与给定文字最相似的前 K 行，输出新的相似度表。
identity.when_to_use: 围绕一个说法找相关评论/帖子，而不是按关键词精确过滤。

ai.summary: 用本地句向量找出与给定文字最相似的前 K 行，输出新的相似度表。
when_not_to_use: 要删除重复内容用 semantic_dedupe；按列值精确筛选用 filter_rows。
prerequisites: An upstream table (the analysis node’s input).
`column` names a column that must exist (default: none — required).
steps: Put a step `{"op": "similar_to", …}` in the analysis node’s `steps`, or set `operation` to `similar_to`.
A missing column, a blank required box or a value outside a declared select refuses by name.
The step returns a NEW table with columns `rank`, `row_index`, `text`, `similarity`.
failures: A named column the table does not hold: `analysis.step_col_missing`.
A blank required parameter: `analysis.need_param`.
A value outside a declared select: `analysis.bad_option`.
acceptance: The output table carries exactly: rank, row_index, text, similarity.

identity.description: 按一列与给定值的比较（等于/包含/大于/为空…）保留或删除行。
identity.when_to_use: 把分析限定在一个子集：某平台、某时间段、包含某个词。

ai.summary: 按一列与给定值的比较（等于/包含/大于/为空…）保留或删除行。
when_not_to_use: 要按另一张表的键去重/剔除用 anti_join；只挑列用 select_columns。
prerequisites: An upstream table (the analysis node’s input).
`column` names a column that must exist (default: none — required).
steps: Put a step `{"op": "filter_rows", …}` in the analysis node’s `steps`, or set `operation` to `filter_rows`.
A missing column, a blank required box or a value outside a declared select refuses by name.
failures: A named column the table does not hold: `analysis.step_col_missing`.
A blank required parameter: `analysis.need_param`.
A value outside a declared select: `analysis.bad_option`.
acceptance: Rows are filtered or reordered; the upstream columns are unchanged.

identity.description: 只保留列出的列（按此顺序），其余列丢弃。
identity.when_to_use: 导出或画图前把表收窄到需要的几列。
